player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop between the Study room and the Living room, repeatedly going east and west without exploring other branches. I failed to track visited rooms or recognize when I was returning to a previously seen location. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms. Upon entering a room, I will check if I have been there before. If I have, I will immediately try a different, untried direction instead of retracing my steps. I will continue this process until I reach the Conservatory and then output "DONE".
